findings.issue: Native keyboard scrolling is overridden while Lenis wheel interpolation is still active. The provider enables document-wide inertia without cancelling it before native keyboard/focus navigation. Installed Lenis onNativeScroll ignores external native changes while isScrolling is smooth, and its RAF keeps writing the old wheel target. Current keyboard tests run after settling and therefore do not cover this failure.
findings.impact: A user switching from wheel scrolling to Home cannot reliably reach the document start; scrolling continues in the opposite direction to the requested key. This violates the required native keyboard/accessibility fallback under active smooth scrolling despite110 green recorded cases.
findings.reproduction: No-preference, viewport1280x800, /en: start at scrollY1500, wheel down1000, press Home about50ms later during interpolation, then observe until settled. Independent actual-build replay ended at2432 instead of0; reduced-motion native control ended0. Same defect reproduced using installed Lenis alone with the exact provider options. No DOM-dispatched synthetic keyboard or forced post-key scroll was used.
findings.fix_direction: Return to original Terra: cancel/reconcile in-flight wheel inertia before native keyboard/focus scrolling without suppressing native behavior, and add an actual-page regression for wheel-to-Home interruption under active motion with reduced-motion/native controls; rerun proportional integrated gates.
